name: pipeline-cards
description: a pane with one card per production pipeline, read from small status files

status_dir.title: Status folder
status_dir.description: The folder your pipelines write their status files into (see FORMAT.md). ~ is your home folder.

notify.title: Notices
notify.description: on shows a short notice when a card turns waiting, error or quiet, or gets a new waiting item; off shows none.
